title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers when he is forced to face the evil Raka, who is sent by an industrialist to destroy humanity.

title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
desc: Sanjana falls in love with Prem Kishen after mistaking him for his boss, Prem Kumar, whom she is actually supposed to marry. But, the relationship is threatened when Prem Kishen reveals the truth.

title: Nadiya Ke Paar
desc: Chandan, a farmer's nephew, is in love with Gunja, his sister-in-law's sibling. However, when her sister dies in an accident, Gunja is expected to marry Chandan's brother.

title: Lal Baadshah
desc: Lal Singh, a righteous and helpful man, clashes against Dayal Singh, a powerful personality. However, things get complicated when a hidden treasure is involved and Lal's tragic past is disclosed.

title: Krantiveer
desc: Pratap, a gambler disowned by his family, comes under the care of a landlord named Laxminath. When corrupt forces lead to Laxminath's murder, Pratap seeks revenge.
